```sql
SELECT s.Fname, s.Age
FROM Student s
WHERE s.StuID IN (
    SELECT hp.StuID
    FROM Has_Pet hp
    JOIN Pets p ON hp.PetID = p.PetID
    WHERE p.PetType = 'dog'
)
AND s.StuID NOT IN (
    SELECT hp.StuID
    FROM Has_Pet hp
    JOIN Pets p ON hp.PetID = p.PetID
    WHERE p.PetType = 'cat'
);
```
